caption: The low crater density and generally smooth surface indicate a relatively young mare plain, with only a few small, sharp-rimmed craters superposed on older, subdued pits. Subtle linear to curvilinear ridges crossing the scene suggest contractional or flexural deformation of coherent basaltic flows, as indicated by their continuous, gently undulating traces. The scarcity of deeply incised crater walls implies modest relief, with crater interiors and rims showing only moderate steepness. This combination of smooth plains and broad ridges may reflect dense, mechanically strong volcanic fill overlying earlier basin structures.
